folderPath.description: A folder inside the data folder of the server (no .. allowed).

fileName.description: The name of the file; only its last component is used.

content.description: Any JSON value (the recorded points are an array); the server writes it pretty-printed as the file.

200.description: Success. The body is documented in docs/REMOTE_API.md.

400.description: Invalid request. The body is documented in docs/REMOTE_API.md.

403.description: Signed in but not allowed. The body is documented in docs/REMOTE_API.md.

500.description: Server error. The body is documented in docs/REMOTE_API.md.
